digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Wednesday, September 30 has eight live meetings, one protected work block, eight carried-over actions, and six urgent items. The day’s priorities are setting the Amazon Connect fix and reporting plan at 10:30 AM, using the 4:00 PM Attorney Review session to close the SLC workflow and coverage gaps, and assigning coverage for the three-way 4:00 PM collision. Amazon Connect remains the clearest delivery risk: Denver is still pending, two production blockers remain open, and the proposed routing change needs validation before a go-live decision.

items.label: Close the Attorney Review workflow and SLC coverage gaps
items.detail: Yesterday’s session aligned the October 17 SLC workflow, but 29 appointments and an estimated 25% rework rate make capacity the key risk. Use today’s 4:00 PM session to confirm the attorney roster, step-by-step ownership, fallback coverage, and any remaining Service Cloud gaps before the October 15 launch.

items.label: Set the revised Mental Health RFE scope
items.detail: The work remains paused after the USCIS policy change reduced the eligible hard-deadline population. Confirm the sponsor decision among the roughly 95 VAWA cases, first-submission, or refile scope, then record the review owners and new planning trigger.

items.label: Confirm all five team self-reviews with HR
items.detail: Jean reported the team’s self-reviews complete, but HR later listed Laura and Mar. Confirm all five submissions are recorded before closing the item.

items.label: Prioritize the Proactive Payday Notification intake
items.detail: The CFO-backed request is in the CM-CoE queue. Confirm its priority, scope, and next owner so the intake moves without delay.

items.label: Close Incident Response communications ownership
items.detail: Confirm the Bucket 6 notification trigger, communication owner, and remaining guide inputs with Amy before tomorrow morning’s project handoff.

items.label: Brief the team on the compliance change protocol
items.detail: Use today’s EPMO meeting to reinforce when Legal must be included and ask teams to pause or coordinate matter-plan changes with the compliance PM until the new standard process is implemented.

items.label: Plan the downward reviews
items.detail: The review cycle runs through October 15. Confirm the assigned reviews, reserve writing time, and coordinate with Eugenia so both managers’ feedback is reflected in Laura’s review.

items.label: Close the Close Case Taskset decisions
items.detail: Yesterday’s discussion indicated a short-term manual review may be workable because closure notes are generally clear. Confirm the affected phases, temporary process, automation boundary, and owner for the next deliverable.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Amazon Connect daily standup
items.detail: Validate the proposed external-routing change, identify the owner and test for both open production blockers, and leave with a Denver go/no-go posture and one reporting format.

items.label: 11:30 AM - Astrid 1:1
items.detail: Use the portfolio discussion to settle priority and ownership questions before the protected noon work block.

items.label: Noon - Protected work block
items.detail: Use the hour for Amazon Connect and Attorney Review follow-through before the uninterrupted afternoon meeting sequence.

items.label: 2:00 PM - EPMO team meeting
items.detail: Reinforce the compliance change protocol, surface the day’s cross-team blockers, and leave with named owners before the 1:1 and portfolio sequence.

items.label: 3:00-4:00 PM - Jhara 1:1 and Legal portfolio review
items.detail: Use Jhara’s 1:1 to prepare the Attorney Review decisions, then carry the priority and blocker readout directly into the Legal portfolio review.

items.label: 4:00 PM - Three-way workflow and leadership collision
items.detail: Attorney Review, the CoE biweekly touchpoint, and weekly-meeting preparation start together; Attorney Review also overlaps the 4:30 PM Sara 1:1. Assign coverage and define the decision or readout required from each session.

items.label: Set the Amazon Connect fix and reporting plan
items.detail: Two Denver blockers remain open after Salesforce proposed changing the Unified Routing method and routing configuration. At 10:30 AM, confirm who will implement and validate the change, the next test window, and a consistent status report for stakeholders.

items.label: Assign coverage for the 4:00 PM collision
items.detail: Choose who will cover Attorney Review, the CoE touchpoint, and weekly-meeting preparation, then protect the decisions Jean needs before joining Sara at 4:30 PM.

items.label: Review the new project security alert
items.detail: Identify the affected project and vulnerability, confirm whether exposure is active, and assign the remediation owner and due date.

items.label: Decide Idalia’s Client Services access request
items.detail: Review the SharePoint access request, confirm the business need and appropriate permission level, then approve or decline it.

items.label: Eugenia Barragán is out through October 1
items.detail: Route time-sensitive CoE and portfolio decisions around her absence, including Laura’s review coordination.

items.label: 10:00 AM - Incident Response Guide handoff
items.detail: Bring the confirmed communications owner, Bucket 6 trigger, and remaining guide inputs so the handoff closes open ownership questions.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Attorney Review BD session conflicts with Amazon Connect
items.detail: Choose coverage today so the October 15 BD readiness work and the deployment checkpoint both return clear decisions.

items.label: 1:00 PM - Leads Project legal guidance
items.detail: Use the session to resolve the required legal direction and translate it into an executable project decision.

items.label: 3:00 PM - Attorney Review overlaps Thiago and Laura 1:1s
items.detail: The Attorney Review placeholder runs through 4:00 PM, spanning both 1:1s. Confirm whether the placeholder is active and move or delegate the overlapping conversations.
